answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 77 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in thread, queued in inlet, and karst publishes the wait time. A farm of 197 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4321 identities would post 1926 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
